method: Screenshots individually inspected in view_image; bounding rectangles and text ranges checked by browser scripts. No screenshot edits.
notes: All 9 themes preserve their distinct original layout. New connection help and START/A/B aliases are readable at both resolutions.
Glass full-screen menu backdrop in attempt-3 was rejected because it blurred connection and QR help; attempt-4 restricts the backdrop to the arena and leaves connection instructions visible.

Packing and Prism 960 initially had 11px and 32px of clipped tip content. First actual wheel test exposed overflow:hidden. Final scoped vertical overflow-y:auto correction is proven with mouse wheel in scroll-and-visibility-attempt-2. Primary controls and Wi-Fi address remain visible before scrolling.
Neon intentionally hides its sidebar during racing; the menu and pause panel expose QR and Wi-Fi help.

Four long-status screenshots also visually reviewed: twenty-four/en-unavailable, twenty-four/en-stopped, prism-relay/en-registering and prism-relay/zh-unavailable in wifi-status-layout. All 12 status cases include strict card text vertical and horizontal boundary assertions.
